notes.title: Have you filled out the Sky of Tides Play test Questionnaire?
notes.notes:
[h2]Have you play tested Sky of Tides yet?  We want your feedback!  ːsteamthumbsupː
[/h2]
[h3]Follow this link to get to our survey- we can't wait to hear what you think! [url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/C8NTNVB]https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/C8NTNVB [/url].  
[/h3]
Upon completing the survey, please email [u]myahs@loftysky.com[/u] to receive a [b][u]FREE Steam Key[/u][/b] for our previous title, [b]Shuyan Saga![/b]  We only have a few keys to give, so make sure that you fill out the survey and email us ASAP!  

Feedback is one of the most important tools in making great games that our audience loves, so we want to make sure that we hear what you have to say and that we show our appreciation!  We want to thank you in advance for completing this survey and contributing to the development of Sky of Tides! ːsteamhappyː
